rules.title: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance – owner move-in relocation assistance (2026 inflation adjustment)
rules.requirement: Owners who evict a tenant for owner move-in must pay relocation assistance. The amount is indexed to inflation and adjusted each year by the Rent Board. From January 1, 2026 the standard payment is $19,413, and qualifying households receive an additional $6,471. This reflects a 1.5% CPI adjustment.
rules.key_value: $19,413 standard OMI relocation payment; +$6,471 for qualifying households (effective 2026-01-01)
rules.coverage_conditions: Units covered by Berkeley's Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance where the tenant is evicted for owner move-in
rules.interaction: The Ellis Implementation Ordinance requires the same payment amounts for Ellis Act withdrawals.
rules.quoted_span: The Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance requires owners to pay tenants relocation assistance in the event of an owner move-in eviction.

rules.title: Berkeley Ellis Implementation Ordinance – relocation assistance for Ellis Act withdrawals (2026 inflation adjustment)
rules.requirement: Owners who evict tenants to remove a property from the rental market under the Ellis Act must pay the same relocation assistance as for owner move-in evictions. The amount is indexed to inflation. From January 1, 2026 the standard payment is $19,413, and qualifying households receive an additional $6,471.
rules.key_value: $19,413 standard Ellis relocation payment; +$6,471 for qualifying households (effective 2026-01-01)
rules.coverage_conditions: Tenants evicted so the owner can withdraw the property from the rental housing market (Ellis Act)
rules.interaction: Payment amounts mirror the owner move-in relocation payments under the Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance.
rules.quoted_span: The Ellis Implementation Ordinance requires the same relocation assistance payments for tenants evicted so the owner can remove a property from the rental housing market.
